title: FLA binary read+write drops non-solid stroke styles: styleParam1/styleParam2 skipped on import, written as 0 — dashed/dotted/ragged/stippled/hatched strokes don't survive despite full model+SWF support
description: DONE. Non-solid stroke styles (dashed/dotted/ragged/stippled/hatched) now survive the FLA binary round-trip in BOTH directions. New shared codec fla/stroke-style.ts (decodeStrokeStyle/encodeStrokeStyle) using flacomdoc's byte-verified styleParam1/styleParam2 layout (selector low-3-bits 2/3/4/5; dashed via styleParam1; 0x8000 sharp-corners masked). READ: readLineStyle no longer skips the 4 param bytes -> Fla8Stroke.style; strokeFromFla8 threads to Stroke.style. WRITE: writeLineStyle emits encodeStrokeStyle(s.style) instead of u32(0). Solid/empty encodes {0,0} so byte gates stay green. Tests: stroke-style.test.ts (14, selector-bit pinning + round-trip) + stroke-style-roundtrip.test.ts (6, full saveRealFla->tryLoadRealFla per style deep-equal). Verified: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0; pnpm --filter @flash/core test --run = 356 files / 5815 pass, 2 skip. Byte gates GREEN: empty-bytematch (6, 1 skip), carchive-validate (10), contents-structure (5). Real-FLA GREEN: real-fla-write 88 incl Magnet CPicSwf byte-identical; flash8-import 160; contents-anchor 3. docs/21 §12.2 updated with the stroke-style table + ordinal-mapping caveat.
